ch04.anchor: cooking the hound once the hare is caught
ch04.note: The proverb tu si gou peng (兔死狗烹), 'the hare dead, the hound is boiled,' from Sima Qian: Fan Li's warning that 'when the cunning hare is dead the hunting dog is cooked'—a ruler discards the servant whose usefulness is spent. Chen lists it among the treacheries he says the Chinese service, unlike others, refused to practice on its own men.

ch04.anchor: air-dropping our working comrades one by one into the mainland
ch04.note: Chen alludes to the American covert operations of the early 1950s. From 1950 the CIA, working out of Taiwan under the cover of Western Enterprises, Inc., trained Nationalist agents and parachuted them into the mainland to raise a 'Third Force' against the Communists; almost every team was caught or turned, and many men were lost for nothing. The best-known instance was the shoot-down over Manchuria in November 1952 of the CIA officers John Downey and Richard Fecteau, held in China for some twenty years. Chen's bitterness is that of a man who lost comrades to it.
